title: Guía de inicio en español para rcol
text: El paquete organiza sus 46 funciones públicas en dos familias: col_*(): Funciones de alto nivel diseñadas para trabajar directamente con la versión extendida más reciente del Catalogue Life ("3LXR"). La versión se fija automáticamente en la sesión (col_key()). clb_*(): Funciones universales de bajo nivel que aceptan el argumento dataset = para consultar cualquier conjunto de datos publicado en ChecklistBank.
code: col_key()      # Clave numérica fijada para la sesión col_refresh()  # Fuerza la actualización a una versión más reciente

title: Getting started with rcol
text: functions come two forms: col_*() target latest extended COL release without needing dataset argument. "3LXR" release alias resolved integer dataset key cached session via col_key(), long-running work disrupted new release published midway. Use col_refresh() deliberately re-pin newest release. clb_*() take dataset = argument work dataset ChecklistBank historical COL releases.
code: col_key()      # Pinned integer dataset key of the latest extended release #> [1] 315834 col_refresh()  # Re-resolve to the newest release #> Pinned COL to "COL26.7 XR" (dataset 315834).

title: Getting started with rcol
text: Almost every function takes dataset = argument identifying checklist work . can pass: numeric dataset key, e.g. 3 (COL project), dataset alias "COL25" (2025 annual release), one magic COL release aliases always resolve recent release ("3LR" monthly base, "3LXR" monthly extended).

what: R Client for the Catalogue of Life / ChecklistBank API
title: R Client for the Catalogue of Life / ChecklistBank API
text: rcol R client Catalogue Life via ChecklistBank API (https://api.checklistbank.org). allows verify match scientific names, retrieve hierarchical classifications, look datasets, taxa, synonyms, vernacular names, geographic distributions, run ChecklistBank parsers — public dataset ChecklistBank latest Catalogue Life release. modelled conventions rgbif taxadb. Note Origin & Architectural Evolution: package builds upon original rcol project Catalogue Life (https://catalogueoflife.github.io/rcol/). version introduces substantial architectural enhancements simplify scientific workflows, including: - Direct Scientific Name Support: Pass scientific names directly (e.g., "Panthera leo" "Werneria nubigena") downstream functions without needing prior manual ID lookups. - Vectorized Multi-Species Queries: Seamlessly pass character vectors multiple species (e.g., c("Werneria nubigena", "Panthera leo")) receive clean, concatenated tidy data frames. - Species Traceability: Preserves species association (scientific_name column) across synonyms, vernacular/common names, distribution records. - Clean Name Verification: col_check_name() returns essential 9-column resolution summary showing accepted names, status, IDs. - Flexible Classification Extraction: col_classification() supports Long format desanided Wide format (wide = TRUE). two parallel families functions: col_*() convenience functions target latest extended Catalogue Life release ("3LXR"). first use, release key pinned session (col_key()), ensuring long-running jobs never disrupted mid-session release updates. Use col_refresh() re-pin. clb_*() universal low-level functions accept explicit dataset = argument (e.g., "COL25", 2099) query dataset ChecklistBank.

title: R Client for the Catalogue of Life / ChecklistBank API
text: match specific dataset instead latest COL release, use clb_*() form dataset = key alias:
code: library(rcol)  # High-level clean verification (9 columns) for 1 or multiple species col_check_name(c("Werneria nubigena", "Panthera leo", "Schinus molle"))  # Raw matching against the latest Catalogue of Life release col_match("Panthera leo")  # Disambiguate with rank and nomenclatural code col_match("Abies alba", rank = "species", code = "botanical")  # See all candidate matches (homonyms), not just the best one col_match_verbose("Oenanthe")  # Match many names at once in parallel col_match_checklist(c("Panthera leo", "Bufo bufo", "Abies alba")) clb_match("Felis catus", dataset = "COL25")          # 2025 annual release clb_match("Macrocystis pyrifera", dataset = 2099)    # public dataset by key

title: R Client for the Catalogue of Life / ChecklistBank API
text: functions work seamlessly direct scientific names, IDs, character vectors, match data frames:
code: # Hierarchical classification in Wide or Long format col_classification("Schinus molle", wide = TRUE)  # Synonyms for 1 or multiple species col_synonyms(c("Werneria nubigena", "Panthera leo"))  # Vernacular / common names with species association (scientific_name column) col_vernacular(c("Werneria nubigena", "Panthera leo"))  # Geographic distribution in tidy format col_distribution(c("Werneria nubigena", "Schinus molle"))  # Details of a name usage col_usage("Panthera leo")
